title: A maintained, tested audit script for the final-diff audit of authority text (/review-changes Step 7)
outcome: An auditing coordinator runs one maintained script that lists the changed passages of authority text in a frozen change and finds each in the recorded concurrences, so two auditors reach the same result on the same input.
acceptance: A script under scripts/ takes a worktree and a file of recorded concurrence sentences, derives the changed passages of authority text from the word-level diff (added, altered and removed), normalises whitespace and strips Markdown list and quote markers at line starts, and reports for each passage whether a recorded concurrence contains it, a removed passage only where the concurrence names it as removed.
It prints the worktree's input fingerprint beside its result, computed the way the test launcher computes it.
Tests cover an added, an altered, a removed and a whitespace-only change, a passage inside a bulleted list and one inside a block quote.
